title: EMBRACE: Shaping Inclusive Opinion Representation by Aligning Implicit Conversations with Social Norms
reasoning: The paper centers on 'normative alignment,' introducing a framework to evaluate whether models uphold social and ethical standards by rejecting harmful or toxic viewpoints. It grounds its methodology in normative discourse principles (e.g., Habermas and Grice) to assess the moral and social alignment of LLMs, making ethics and social norms a core component of the research.
